title: Sort Array by Frequency
statement:
Given an array of N integers, sort it in descending order of element frequency. If two elements have the same frequency, sort them in ascending order of their value.

Print the resulting array.
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers on a single line.

examples.explanation: Frequencies: 4→3, 5→2, 3→1, 6→1. Sorted desc freq: 4(×3), 5(×2), then 3 and 6 have same freq=1 sorted ascending.
Both 1 and 2 have frequency 2. Same frequency → sort by value ascending: 1,1,2,2.
